topic: Firmware release planning and data consumption
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the timing of a firmware release. Initially, an epic was created for planned tasks scheduled for Autumn 2021. It was determined that the immediate priority is releasing features related to data consumption reduction. The subsequent fixes (including handling duplicated device IDs and session issues at midnight) can be deferred until a later release.
decisions: The first firmware release will focus on data consumption reduction.
Other planned fixes and tasks can wait for a subsequent release.
